🚀 MARS: BEYOND THE FRONTIER 🔴
A Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
Explore. Survive. Innovate. Secure Humanity’s Future.

🌌 THE MISSION
Mars is cold, silent and unforgiving. Temperatures average around −63°C 🥶, the air is dangerously thin 💨, water and food are scarce 💧🌱, and every astronaut’s health is at risk ☢️. In MARS: Beyond the Frontier, a game built in PenguinMod, players don’t just read about these challenges. They live them. 🎮

You are a junior astronaut on a glowing, futuristic Mars base, and an epidemic is threatening the settlement. 🦠 Your mission is to train, research, build and survive, and to find the cure that protects humanity’s first home on another world. 🌍➡️🔴

🛰️ ONE BASE. MULTIPLE MISSIONS.
A connected base where every room has its own purpose:

  • 🏠 Main Room (Lobby): the command hub that links the whole base. Press V from any room to return here instantly.
  • 🎛️ Critical Controls Room: the base’s control centre, where players build and manage the habitat’s power, life support and equipment, and respond to warnings and failures. ⚠️ 
  • 🏋️ Training Room: a level-based mini-game where players build their skills and earn credits. 🪙 
  • 🌿 Greenhouse: food and plant growth for the settlement.
  • 🚪 Exit Room: a rover mission across the Martian surface. 🚙

⚡ BUILD, MANAGE, SURVIVE
From the Equipment Room, players take control of a habitat with three modes: Build 🏗️, Watch 👀 and Manage 🎛️.

  • 🔋 Power: solar panels and batteries keep everything running, and a day and night cycle decides when solar power is available and when batteries must take over.
  • 🫁 Life support: oxygen, air circulation, lighting and communications each have their own status, and each can be powered by solar or battery.
  • 🌱 Growth and technology: modules such as a plant lab, a robot arm, a docking port and extra rooms can be added to the station.
  • 🪙 Economy: the base earns money while its systems are running, and players choose what to buy. Some upgrades cost more than they can afford, so they must prioritise.
  • ⚠️ Warnings and failures: when a system fails, alerts appear. A failure in one area, such as power, spreads to the others, so players see why every part of the base depends on the rest.

Players learn that one bad decision can cost a settlement, and one smart one can save it.

🏆 TRAIN. PROGRESS. EARN.
Training is where astronauts get ready for the real missions. Players take on level-based challenges in an arcade-style mini-game 🕹️ where the score climbs the longer they survive, and they earn credits to spend on upgrades and gear. 🔧

Hit a high enough score and the screen lights up with “YOU FOUND THE CURE!” 🎉, and the game launches the player straight into the Exit Room for the rover mission. Training, research and exploration come together as one mission. 🎯

🚙 THE ROVER MISSION
Outside the base, players drive a rover through a multi-level Martian landscape 🌄 with rocks, lava, platforms and laser-equipped tech to handle, while Mars’s moons Phobos and Deimos drift across the sky. 🌑 Completing the mission earns a victory screen, and the Back to Main Room button or Esc takes the player home. 🏁

🎬 BUILT TO FEEL LIKE A MOVIE
Neon-blue holographic interfaces glow against the red Martian landscape. 🌅 Cinematic intro screens, atmospheric sound and a space-station ending with fireworks 🎆 give the whole game the feel of a space film.

⌨️ Controls: W/A/S/D or the arrow keys to move, K for the in-game action, mouse clicks for doors, buttons and equipment, and V to return to the Main Room.

🎓 WHAT YOUNG ASTRONAUTS LEARN

  • 🧠 Systems thinking: every part of a base depends on the others.
  • ⚖️ Trade-offs: limited power, limited money and competing demands force real choices.
  • 🔋 Energy management: why solar power isn’t always available and what backup power is for.
  • 🔬 Science matters: research is what makes long-term survival in space possible.
  • 🤝 Planning, teamwork and problem-solving: the skills real mission crews rely on.

🎯 WHY IT FITS THE CHALLENGE
The challenge asks students to run a Martian outpost and balance competing demands. Our game does this by making players manage power, life support, plant growth and money, then respond when something goes wrong. They experience first-hand what decides whether a mission fails or succeeds, and they do it through an exciting game rather than a textbook. 🚀

✨ Explore. Survive. Innovate. Secure Humanity’s Future! ✨
